headline: 愛丁堡藝穗新秀作品
context: 愛丁堡藝穗這幾天有兩齣話題新秀作品登場。理察森（Harriet Richardson）的個人秀《Creep》，講她被一名資深喜劇演員搭訕後，展開一段花了六個月追蹤對方的離奇經過。艾曼達・諾克斯（Amanda Knox）——當年在義大利被控謀殺室友、後來獲判無罪——則首度嘗試單口喜劇，在《Cartwheel》裡以初為人母的角度重新講述自己的故事。

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: Pleasance Courtyard, Edinburgh With the air of a hungover postmortem, Richardson gives a head-spinning account of an encounter with an older comedian If you’re partial to a bit of gossip and scandal, Harriet Richardson is your girl. In this gloriously juicy debut hour, she dishes the dirt on the DMs she received from an older comedian and the intense, utterly absorbing events that followed. Yes, she found his eBay account. And yes, she spent six months tracking him down on a dating app only to play his profile song hundreds of times. But what else is a girl driven by obsession supposed to do? We meet Richardson, who until now has worked primarily as a performance artist, all smiles and ready to share. She takes us back to the creation of her 2024 viral piece 100 Dates , in which she spent Valentine’s Day online speed-dating in an attempt to analyse her relationship with infatuation and connection. The comedian in question used the project as the opening line of his first message to her. What followed is flirtation so blatant it makes your toes curl: “Do you want to see my trophy?”; a string of saucy snaps; and finally a frantic voice note from the comedian’s manager bringing the whole messaging saga to an abrupt end. At Pleasance Courtyard, Edinburgh , until 30 August All our Edinburgh festival reviews Continue reading...
sources.title: Harriet Richardson: Creep review – a scandalous delve into shame and desire

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: Gilded Balloon Teviot, Edinburgh Performer cleared of death of her roommate in Italy uses new motherhood as framework for her defiant comedy show ‘Welcome to the most controversial show on the fringe !” Some audiences will diagnose self-regard in that intro by rookie standup Amanda Knox. For others, as for Knox herself, it merely acknowledges the continuing efforts to silence her. But then, Knox is “the human version of the blue/gold dress”, a canvas on to which we all project guilty, innocent – or weird. Her innocence now proved, it’s the last of these charges she takes on in this fringe outing, retelling her oft-told tale through the lens of new motherhood. Is it a disgrace that she’s telling it at all – and profiting from it, some would say (although they’ve presumably never taken a show to the Edinburgh fringe)? Classifying Cartwheel as comedy may be a misstep; it risks looking insensitive and inaccurately describes the show. But, judging by the evidence, Knox would be damned whatever she did. Now at least she can tell her story in her own way, articulating a growing anger at her treatment and a determination to raise her daughter, not to be silenced and scared but “to be the exact girl I was punished for being”. At Gilded Balloon Teviot, Edinburgh , until 17 August All our Edinburgh festival reviews Continue reading...
sources.title: Amanda Knox in Cartwheel review – rookie standup acquitted of murder tells her story

thread_text:
愛丁堡藝穗這幾天有兩齣話題新秀作品登場。

理察森（Harriet Richardson）的個人秀《Creep》，講她被一名資深喜劇演員搭訕後，花了六個月追蹤對方、甚至找到對方 eBay 帳號的離奇經過，最後以對方經紀人一通慌張的語音訊息收場。艾曼達・諾克斯（Amanda Knox）——當年在義大利被控謀殺室友、後來獲判無罪——首度嘗試單口喜劇，在《Cartwheel》裡以初為人母的角度重新講述自己的故事。

—— 本則整理自 The Guardian 於 2026 年 8 月 11 日發佈的報導，讓圖書館員翻譯給你聽。
